welcome_text: Welcome to the Digital Catalogue System(Library) of the University of Computer Studies, Hinthada.
intro_desc: The Digital Catalogue System is a dedicated digital platform developed for the students, faculty, and researchers of the University of Computer Studies, Hinthada. As a premier technological institution, we recognize the importance of seamless information retrieval. This system serves as a bridge, connecting our academic community to a vast repository of technical books, research papers, and educational resources.
vision_desc: Our mission is to modernize the library experience by integrating advanced web technologies into our day-to-day operations. We aim to foster a culture of academic excellence and continuous learning by providing a robust, user-friendly, and accessible catalog system that meets the evolving needs of IT students and scholars.
service_list: Our system offers comprehensive features including real-time book searching, digitized borrowing history, secure booking capabilities, and instant communication with our library administration. We are committed to making library resources more accessible, efficient, and transparent for all UCSH members.
location: Located on the campus of the University of Computer Studies, Hinthada, Ayeyarwady Region, Myanmar. We are here to support your educational journey.
footer_credit: Developed with  by Yan Naing Soe & Shwe Yi Shoon Lei.
faq_desc: Find answers to the most common questions about our library system.
q1: How can I search for a book?
a1: You can use the search bar on the homepage to search by book title, author, abstract, content or category.
q2: How many books can I borrow?
a2: You can borrow up to a maximum of :limit books at a time.
q3: What is the penalty for late returns?
a3: A fine of :fine Kyats per day will be charged for any book returned after the due date.
q4: How do I book a library book?
a4: Click on the 'Book Now' button on the book details page. You must collect the book within :hours hours.
q5: Where can I see my borrowing history?
a5: You can view your history by logging into your account and visiting the 'My Borrowings' section.
welcome_footer: A library catalog system where students can seek out knowledge and information.
